_meta.note: Cross-referenced against Chabbi/2026-09-17-credit-test-pack.md (K1-K8), the authoritative business-rules writeup for this feature. Source-of-truth columns are never modified; automation only writes Actual Result/Status/Comments/Date Tested via cypress/utils/excelUpdater.js.
_meta.importantConstraint: Unlike the Stripe suite, these test accounts hold FIXED, NOT-automatically-replenished credit balances ('each balance is spent by the test that uses it' - no self-service top-up exists yet). This suite is NOT freely re-runnable like a normal CI regression suite: re-running a balance-consuming case a second time will find the balance already spent and fail for a reason that has nothing to do with the app. Do not re-run TC-STR-style repeatedly to 'stabilize' it — check the account's real balance first (see docs/features/credit-checkout.md).
_meta.knownBlocker: qa-credit-50@designerex.com.au was found to already be at $0.00 credit (verified live via the dx_calculate_credit RPC on 2026-09-17, before any test in this suite ran) instead of the pack's stated $50.00 — almost certainly consumed when the pack's own author measured the K1 figures earlier the same day. Per the pack's own instruction ('tell Chhabi when an account needs topping up rather than raising it as a bug'), every case that depends on qa-credit-50 (K1, K5, K6 = CR-TC-001-003, 016-021) is Blocked pending a top-up, not treated as an app bug.

testCases.description: Verify credit cannot be consumed twice for a single booking
testCases.expectedResult: Only one booking/payment transaction is created. Credit is deducted only once. No duplicate Stripe payment or duplicate credit consumption occurs.

automation.reason: A live attempt at this (direct authorise-booking replay, same technique as the Stripe suite's TC-STR-018) ran alongside the CR-TC-043/044 execution but its own result wasn't cleanly confirmed before that test run needed to be stopped (an unrelated timing issue caused the run to report failure after the booking had already been created) — spending more of qa-credit-150's balance again just to re-confirm this one assertion wasn't judged worth it this pass. The underlying idempotency mechanism (reused:true) is already proven for full-payment reservations by the Stripe suite's TC-STR-018.
